subject_uz: Mikrokreditbank mijozlari uchun 1500 dona Uzcard POS-terminallari xaridi

requirements.summary_uz: Terminallar 2025 yildan oldin ishlab chiqarilmagan bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Terminals must not have been manufactured before 2025.
requirements.quote: 2025 yildan oldin ishlab chiqarilmagan bo'lishi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Yetkazib beriladigan terminallar soni 1500 dona bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The number of terminals delivered must be 1,500 units.
requirements.quote: To'lov terminallari soni e'lon qilingan miqdorga mos kelishi kerak: Miqdori - 1.500 (bir ming besh yuz) dona

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi o'xshash qurilmalarni sotish yoki ijaraga berish tajribasiga ega bo'lishi va buni shartnoma, hisob-faktura yoki dalolatnoma bilan tasdiqlashi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder needs experience selling or renting similar devices, proved by contracts, invoices or acceptance acts.
requirements.quote: O'xshash qurilmalarni sotish yoki ijaraga berish tajribasiga ega bo'lish.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi qurilma ishlab chiqaruvchisidan avtorizatsiya (vakillik) xatiga ega bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must hold an authorisation from the device manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi qurilma ishlab chiqaruvchisidan avtorizatsiyagaegabo'lishi lozim.

requirements.summary_uz: O'zbekistonda vakolatli servis markazi mavjud bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: An authorised service centre must exist in Uzbekistan.
requirements.quote: O'zbekiston Respublikasida vakolatli servis markazi mavjud bo'lishi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Yetkazib beruvchi Uzcard protsessing markazining dasturiy ta'minotga ulanish va dasturlash bo'yicha litsenziyasiga ega bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The supplier must hold the Uzcard processing centre's licence for software connection and programming.
requirements.quote: dasturiy ta'minotga bog'lanish, dasturlash bo'yicha tegishli litsenziyasiga ega bo'lishi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Bankdan oxirgi 6 oylik bank aylanmasi, qarzdorlik va hisobvaraqqa taqiq bo'yicha ma'lumot ball beriladigan mezon sifatida talab qilinadi (10 ball).
requirements.summary_en: A bank certificate with 6 months of turnover, arrears and account restrictions is scored as a criterion (10 points).
requirements.quote: Faoliyat yurituvchi bankdan ma’lumot: 1. Asosiy hisobvaraqlar harakatda ekanligi, tanlash e’lon qilingan sanadan oxirgi 6 oylik bank aylanmasi

requirements.summary_uz: Soliq idorasi tasdiqlagan so'nggi yillik moliyaviy hisobot (balans) uchun 10 ball beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: The latest annual financial statement (balance sheet) certified by the tax office is scored (10 points).
requirements.quote: Soliq idorasi tomonidan tasdiqlangan so’nggi yillik moliyaviy xisobot (balans)

requirements.summary_uz: Respublika hududlarida servis markazlari mavjudligi uchun 15 ballgacha beriladi (1-5 hudud: 5 ball, 6-13 hudud: 10 ball, barcha hududlar: 15 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Service centres across the country score up to 15 points (1-5 regions: 5, 6-13 regions: 10, all regions: 15).
requirements.quote: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi hududlarida servis markazlari mavjudligi (Servislarni mavjudligi to‘g‘risida asoslantiruvchi hujjat)

requirements.summary_uz: Direktor va ta'sischining pasport nusxasi yoki ID karta ham ball beriladigan mezon hisoblanadi (10 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Copies of the director's and founder's passport or ID card are themselves a scored criterion (10 points).
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi korxonasining direktor va ta’sischisining passport nusxasi yoki ID card

reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Ishlab chiqaruvchi yoki diler xati talabi (7-bet): POS-terminallar bozorda erkin sotiladi, biroq ishtirokchidan ishlab chiqaruvchining avtorizatsiya xati talab qilinmoqda. Bunday xat bo'lmasa, 5,25 mlrd so'mlik lotda mustaqil yetkazib beruvchilar qatnasha olmasligi mumkin. Talabning sababi (kafolat, servis) aniq ko'rsatilmagan.

Haddan tashqari tor texnik parametrlar (3-bet): Terminalning o'lchamlari yuzdan bir millimetrgacha (190,36 mm) va vazni 395 g deb ko'rsatilgan, operatsion tizim esa aynan bitta ishlab chiqaruvchining platformasi (Paydroid) deb nomlangan. Bunday kombinatsiya bitta modelni tasvirlayotganga o'xshaydi. Hujjatda funksional jihatdan o'xshash jihozlar ham ko'rib chiqilishi aytilgan, shuning uchun aniqlashtirish yetarli.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 19 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 4 ta; savdolarning 16% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 5%.
Diqqat: hujjatning 4 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Manufacturer or dealer letter required (page 7): POS terminals are freely traded, yet the bidder must hold a manufacturer authorisation letter. Without it, independent suppliers may be unable to bid on this 5.25 billion UZS lot. The reason (warranty, service) is not stated.

Over-narrow technical parameters (page 3): Dimensions are given to a hundredth of a millimetre (190.36 mm) with a weight of 395 g, and the operating system is named as one manufacturer's platform (Paydroid). The combination looks like a single model. The document does say functionally similar devices will be considered, so a clarification is enough.
In the customer's last 19 deals the median number of bidders was 4; 16% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 5%.
Note: 4 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.

documents_needed_uz: Faoliyat yurituvchi bankdan ma'lumot (6 oylik aylanma, Kartoteka-2, hisobvaraqqa taqiq, muddati o'tgan qarz)
Soliq idorasi tasdiqlagan so'nggi yillik balans
Direktor va ta'sischining pasport nusxasi yoki ID karta (yuridik shaxs ta'sischi bo'lsa ustav va benefitsiar mulkdor hujjati)
Ijara yoki sotish tajribasini tasdiqlovchi shartnoma yoki hisob-faktura
Uzcard protsessing markazi bilan dasturiy ta'minot bo'yicha kelishuv yoki litsenziya
Taklif etilayotgan terminalning texnik va foydalanish hujjatlari (har bir talab bo'yicha asoslovchi hujjat)
Ishtirokchining qonunbuzarlikka yo'l qo'ymaslik to'g'risidagi arizasi
clarification_letter_uz:
Kimga: MIKROKREDITBANK ATB, xarid komissiyasiga
Lot raqami: 26120012524509
Xarid predmeti: “Mikrokreditbank” ATB mijozlari uchun Pos terminallari (UZCARD) xarid qilish yuzasidan
Mavzu: xarid hujjatlari bo'yicha tushuntirish berish to'g'risida so'rov

Hurmatli xarid komissiyasi a'zolari!

Tashkilotimiz mazkur lot bo'yicha xarid hujjatlari bilan tanishib chiqdi va taklif berish niyatida. Hujjatlardagi quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha tushuntirish berishingizni, zarur deb topilgan taqdirda esa ularga tegishli o'zgartirish kiritishingizni so'raymiz.

1. Texnik topshiriq, 7-bet.
   Hujjatdagi matn: «Ishtirokchi qurilma ishlab chiqaruvchisidan avtorizatsiyagaegabo'lishi lozim.»
   Savolimiz: POS-terminallar bozorda erkin sotiladi, biroq ishtirokchidan ishlab chiqaruvchining avtorizatsiya xati talab qilinmoqda. Bunday xat bo'lmasa, 5,25 mlrd so'mlik lotda mustaqil yetkazib beruvchilar qatnasha olmasligi mumkin. Talabning sababi (kafolat, servis) aniq ko'rsatilmagan.
   Taklif etilayotgan tahrir: Ishtirokchi qurilma ishlab chiqaruvchisi yoki uning vakolatli vakilidan avtorizatsiya xatiga ega bo'lishi yoki kafolat va servis majburiyatlarini boshqa hujjat bilan (masalan, servis markazi bilan shartnoma) tasdiqlashi mumkin.

2. Texnik topshiriq, 3-bet.
   Hujjatdagi matn: «190.36х81 .2хбЗ mm | 395 g (batareya bilan birga)»
   Savolimiz: Terminalning o'lchamlari yuzdan bir millimetrgacha (190,36 mm) va vazni 395 g deb ko'rsatilgan, operatsion tizim esa aynan bitta ishlab chiqaruvchining platformasi (Paydroid) deb nomlangan. Bunday kombinatsiya bitta modelni tasvirlayotganga o'xshaydi. Hujjatda funksional jihatdan o'xshash jihozlar ham ko'rib chiqilishi aytilgan, shuning uchun aniqlashtirish yetarli.
   Taklif etilayotgan tahrir: O'lchamlar: uzunligi 190 mm gacha, og'irligi 450 g gacha (batareya bilan). Operatsion tizim: Android 12 yoki undan yuqori, to'lov ilovalarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan.

Mazkur shartlarga aniqlik kiritilishi xarid predmetini yetkazib bera oladigan barcha ishtirokchilarning teng sharoitda qatnashishiga va raqobatning kengayishiga xizmat qiladi, deb hisoblaymiz.

Javobingizni tushuntirishlar berish muddati tugagunga qadar (24.11.2026 11:20) elektron tizim orqali taqdim etishingizni so'raymiz.
